pageDesc: How often the most likely match result in {{brand}} AI analyses actually happened. Informational statistics.
heroSub: How often the predictions our AI analyses highlighted before kick-off actually happened. Informational statistical prediction.
evalDone: Done: {{evaluated}} evaluated, {{skipped}} skipped, {{errors}} errors. You can refresh the page.
noDataEmptyHint: Results are listed here once «AI Analysis» is generated on a match page.
noDataAdmin: Click «Compare With Results» above for finished matches.
pendingBanner: {{total}} analyses saved; {{count}} not yet compared to final results.
byPhaseHint: Pre-match and half-time analyses are counted separately. Half-time analyses usually keep the pre-match result probabilities.
cronStale: Scheduled jobs have not run for more than {{n}} minutes — check cron-job.org.
disclaimer: Past accuracy is not an indicator of future results. Predictions are informational; no outcome is promised. 18+
topPicksHint: The 3 picks highlighted at the top of each analysis card are checked after the match. Since 22 Nov 2026 they are the picks above 50% that differ most from the base rate (before that: the 3 highest-probability picks, e.g. 2+ goals, home team finds the net). Only analyses from the current model (since 3 Oct 2026) whose match page is available are counted.
summarySentence: The top 3 picks highlighted on Scor3 AI analysis cards came true in {{hits}} of {{picks}} picks across {{matches}} evaluated matches ({{rate}}%).
baseIntro: The picks highlighted on the card are mostly events that are common anyway (2+ goals, home team scores). Saying the same kinds of picks for every match would hit {{base}}%; the model hit {{rate}}% — a {{diff}} pt difference.
baseNote: Base rate: how often the event happened across all {{n}} evaluated matches (whether or not the model picked it). Pick types chosen fewer than 5 times are not listed.
calIntro: The average probability shown on the cards is {{shown}}%; the actual rate is {{actual}}%. Points above the dashed line mean the card understates the probability.
calBrier: Brier score {{brier}} (base rate {{base}}; lower is better) · skill vs base rate {{skill}}.
grpNote: In each row the base rate uses how often that group's pick types happened across all matches. Groups with fewer than 20 matches are a small sample.
